title: Example 02: Order workspace
summary: A real model operating a business queue with record-aware actions, a confirmation gate, and one shared assistant sidebar.
summaryZh: 让真实模型操作业务队列，包含记录级动作、确认闸门，以及一个共享助手侧栏。

files.label: README.md
files.role: Purpose, run command, and source map
files.roleZh: 用途、运行命令与源码导览

guide.title: Teach an agent to run a real business queue
guide.titleZh: 让 Agent 操作一条真实业务队列
intro: The order workspace keeps its own cards, buttons, filters, and approval rules. Pling adds a semantic surface beside that UI; it does not replace the Vue implementation.
The model sees actions and the fields you expose, not your whole component state. Risky actions stay behind a confirmation gate declared beside the business control.
introZh: 订单工作台保留自己的卡片、按钮、筛选与审批规则。Pling 在现有界面旁增加一层语义描述，不替换 Vue 实现。
模型看到的是动作和你主动暴露的字段，而不是整个组件状态。高风险动作位于业务控件旁的确认闸门之后。

steps.title: Keep the provider key on the server
steps.titleZh: 把模型密钥留在服务端
body: The browser uses a relative /api/agent/v1 path. The gateway reads PLING_UPSTREAM_BASE_URL and PLING_UPSTREAM_API_KEY, forces one model, and applies a request quota.
The same file works locally and on a hosted deployment behind /api/agent.
bodyZh: 浏览器只使用相对路径 /api/agent/v1。网关读取 PLING_UPSTREAM_BASE_URL 与 PLING_UPSTREAM_API_KEY，固定模型并执行请求配额。
同一个文件既可用于本地，也可用于部署在 /api/agent 后面的线上环境。

steps.title: Create the shared runtime
steps.body: The page creates one Pling runtime. It owns action discovery, page identity, the agent loop, and the model configuration supplied by the environment.
steps.bodyZh: 页面只创建一个 Pling 运行时，由它负责动作发现、页面身份、Agent 循环，以及从环境读取的模型配置。

steps.title: Declare actions beside the existing buttons
steps.titleZh: 在原有按钮旁声明动作
steps.body: A tool declaration lives next to the Vue control it operates. There is no parallel automation script to maintain: the same button click and the same Vue handler run for a person and for the agent.
steps.bodyZh: 动作声明紧挨着它操作的 Vue 控件。这里没有另一套需要维护的自动化脚本：人和 Agent 触发的是同一个按钮点击和同一个 Vue 处理函数。

steps.title: Expose records, not the whole store
steps.titleZh: 暴露记录，而不是整个 store
steps.body: v-record gives every card a stable id and a small set of fields the agent can reason about. The action list stays O(verbs), while the data remains O(fields) per visible row.
steps.bodyZh: v-record 为每张卡片提供稳定 id 和一组可供 Agent 推理的字段。动作清单保持为 O(动词)，数据量则按可见行数乘以字段数增长。

steps.title: Make risk explicit
steps.body: Approval is a property of the action, not a prompt instruction. This approve action is marked danger and confirm, so the runtime pauses for a human before the business handler runs.
steps.bodyZh: 审批是动作的属性，不是提示词里的一句要求。这个批准动作标为 danger 且需要 confirm，因此运行时会在业务处理函数执行前停下来等待真人确认。

steps.title: Mount one assistant entry
steps.body: AgentDock provides the chat, activity log, and approval UI. The page supplies a title and optional suggested tasks; it does not import a model client.
steps.bodyZh: AgentDock 提供对话、最近操作和审批界面。页面只提供标题与可选推荐任务，不导入模型客户端。

guide.note: Ask for a high-risk order to be approved. The model requests the action, the page shows a confirmation, and only then does the existing Vue handler update the order.
guide.noteZh: 让助手批准一笔高风险订单。模型发起动作后，页面显示确认；只有真人批准后，原有 Vue 处理函数才会更新订单。
